cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Client Onsite Engineer to provide desktop support for our client in [Location masked].
You are committed to end-user satisfaction and technical/operational stability throughout the organization by managing client systems and technologies in supporting the computing needs of the organization. You're also resourceful and collaborative with excellent communication and customer service skills. A sense of humor is a plus!
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The typical day is… atypical. You might be:
Providing Level 2 support to our client base (Corp/Distribution Center) using our ticketing system ([Product name masked])
Helping to identify and proactively solve problems
Ensuring all pending support tickets are addressed or escalated as necessary
User account management functions such as password resets, and accessing account login problems
Hardware Support
Investigate hardware-related issues, such as malfunctioning keyboards, mice, monitors, or printers
Support various meetings/company events with audio-visual needs, including set up and in-meeting support
Additional responsibilities – May be required:
Manage and maintain computer hardware inventory at assigned location
Collaborate with other IT team members to resolve complex issues or implement IT projects
Document all support activities, including issue descriptions, resolutions, and any equipment changes
Troubleshoot network connectivity problems, both wired and wireless
Maintaining inventory for handheld devices such as Windows CE or Android RF scanners
The consistent thread is that you'll be working with an amazing team of women and men who share your passion for excellence.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
2+ Years of experience with an emphasis on client support or similar role
Strong working knowledge of client technologies, such as:
Windows 10, Mac OSX
Mobile Device iOS and Management
Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Teams
LAN/Wireless LAN and various communication technologies
Active Directory
Proficiency in hardware troubleshooting and repair
Excellent task and time-management skills
Strong analytical approach to problem solving and solution development
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbal and written
Excellent interpersonal skills and willingness to embrace our culture
Strong understanding of customer needs and satisfaction
Ability to work closely with other skill teams and Lines of Business to understand requirements and deliver appropriate solutions
Self-sufficiency with the ability to ask questions and request help when needed
Flexibility and ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
Works on Operations floor; demands may include lifting and moving computer equipment (50 lbs)
Preferred Requirements:
Provide Executive Level support when needed (Windows/Mac)
Familiarity using a purchasing system such as SAP
Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician)
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or Information Systems or equivalent desirable degree

This role is built for someone who takes ownership of end-user satisfaction and the technical stability of client systems across the organization. You are resourceful, communicate well, and bring solid customer service instincts. A sense of humor is a plus!

A Day in the Life: The typical day is… atypical. You might be:
Delivering Level 2 support to our client base (Corp/Distribution Center) through our ticketing system ([Product name masked])
Proactively identifying and resolving problems before they escalate
Ensuring all pending support tickets are resolved or escalated as necessary

Owning hardware support — investigating and resolving issues with keyboards, mice, monitors, and printers
Leading audio-visual setup and in-meeting support for company meetings and events

Maintaining inventory for handheld devices such as Windows CE or Android RF scanners

Excellent task and time-management skills

We are looking for a Client Onsite Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked], providing desktop support for our client at [Location masked].
This role is a good fit if you care about end-user satisfaction and keeping client systems running smoothly. You'll be working directly with users day to day, staying in touch with your team, and handling a mix of technical and support tasks. Being resourceful, communicative, and easy to work with matters here. A sense of humor is a plus!
cond_0438.responsibilities:
The typical day is atypical. You might be:
Providing Level 2 support to our client base (Corp/Distribution Center) using our ticketing system ([Product name masked])
Staying in regular contact with users to identify and proactively solve problems
Making sure all pending support tickets are addressed or escalated as needed, keeping users informed along the way
Handling user account management tasks such as password resets and login issues, often working directly with the person affected
Investigating hardware-related issues, such as malfunctioning keyboards, mice, monitors, or printers
Supporting meetings and company events with audio-visual needs, including setup and in-meeting support — a visible, hands-on part of the role
Additional responsibilities — may be required:
Managing and maintaining computer hardware inventory at the assigned location
Collaborating daily with other IT team members to resolve complex issues or implement IT projects
Documenting all support activities, including issue descriptions, resolutions, and equipment changes
Troubleshooting network connectivity problems, both wired and wireless
Maintaining inventory for handheld devices such as Windows CE or Android RF scanners
Throughout all of this, you'll be working closely with a team that takes the work seriously and communicates openly.
cond_0438.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
2+ Years of experience in client support or a similar role
Strong working knowledge of client technologies, including:
Windows 10, Mac OSX
Mobile Device iOS and Management
Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Teams
LAN/Wireless LAN and various communication technologies
Active Directory
Proficiency in hardware troubleshooting and repair
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and to explain issues clearly to users and team members
Strong understanding of customer needs and satisfaction
Ability to work closely with other skill teams and Lines of Business to understand requirements and deliver appropriate solutions
Excellent task and time-management skills
Flexibility to work both autonomously and as part of a team
Self-sufficiency with the ability to ask questions and request help when needed
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with a purchasing system such as SAP
Experience providing Executive Level support (Windows/Mac)
Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
Working Conditions:
Works on Operations floor
Demands may include lifting and moving computer equipment (50 lbs)

You are committed to end-user satisfaction and technical and operational stability across the organization by taking ownership of client systems and technologies to meet the computing needs of the business. You are resourceful and collaborative, with strong communication and customer service skills. A sense of humor is a plus!
cond_0521.responsibilities:
The typical day is atypical. You might be:
Delivering Level 2 support to our client base (Corp/Distribution Center) using our ticketing system ([Product name masked])
Proactively identifying and resolving problems
Ensuring all pending support tickets are addressed or escalated as necessary
Executing user account management functions such as password resets and resolving account login issues
Owning hardware support
Investigating and resolving hardware-related issues, such as malfunctioning keyboards, mice, monitors, or printers
Leading audio-visual setup and in-meeting support for various meetings and company events
Additional responsibilities – May be required:
Manage and maintain computer hardware inventory at assigned location
Drive resolution of complex issues in collaboration with other IT team members, or lead implementation of IT projects
Document all support activities, including issue descriptions, resolutions, and any equipment changes
Troubleshoot and resolve network connectivity problems, both wired and wireless
Maintaining inventory for handheld devices such as Windows CE or Android RF scanners
cond_0521.requirements:
Strong working knowledge of client technologies, such as:
Windows 10, Mac OSX
Mobile Device iOS and Management
Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Teams
LAN/Wireless LAN and various communication technologies
Active Directory
Provide Executive Level support when needed (Windows/Mac)
Familiarity using a purchasing system such as SAP
Excellent task and time-management skills
Very strong analytical approach to problem solving and solution development
Flexibility and ability to work autonomously and as part of a team environment
Strong understanding of customer needs and satisfaction
Results-oriented troubleshooting and commitment to excellence
Must be able to work closely with other skill teams and Lines of Business to understand requirements and deliver appropriate solution
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbal and written
Excellent interpersonal skills and willingness to embrace our culture
Self-sufficiency with the ability to ask questions and request help when needed
2+ Years of experience with an emphasis on client support or similar role
Proficiency in hardware troubleshooting and repair
Customer-oriented approach and ability to provide exceptional customer service
Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician) are a plus
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or Information System or equivalent desirable degree are a plus
Working Conditions:
Works on Operations floor
Demands may include lifting and moving computer equipment (50 lbs)
